title: Leo Music v11.6.6 — Native In-App Music Video Player (480p/720p/1080p) & Edge-to-Edge Full-Screen
notes: Adds Native In-App Original Music Video playback! Switch between Music & Video in Now Playing (plays inside the banner) and Full-Screen (plays full edge-to-edge cinema mode), choose 480p / 720p / 1080p right beside Play/Pause, with 40-second anti-buffer preloading and automatic audio-clock sync.
